goals.text: By Spring 2027, 70% of students in classrooms taught by CTR Alumni in years 2 and 3 of their commitment score at least the 50th percentile on the relevant EOY exam.
goals.numerator_def: Students of year 2 and 3 CTR Alumni scoring at or above the 50th percentile on the relevant EOY exam (PreK Phonics/Math, K-2 MAP 60th+ and DIBELS, grades 3-4 and secondary SBAC Interims and DC CAPE).
goals.denominator_def: Students in classrooms taught by year 2 and 3 CTR Alumni with an EOY exam result. Aggregate numbers only; no student-level data.

goals.text: Residents earn 3.0+ on each 100% Cycle indicator (CC.A.4 to CC.A.7)
goals.numerator_def: Enrolled first-year residents scoring 3.0 or higher on every one of CC.A.4, CC.A.5, CC.A.6, and CC.A.7.
goals.denominator_def: Enrolled first-year residents with Eval 3 scores.
goals.baseline_note: CTR 70%; Eval 3 90%. Baseline uses the Eval 3 figure.

goals.text: Residents earn 3.0+ on CK.P.1
goals.numerator_def: Enrolled first-year residents scoring 3.0 or higher on CK.P.1.
goals.denominator_def: Enrolled first-year residents with Eval 3 scores.
goals.baseline_note: CTR 58%; Eval 3 92%. Baseline uses the Eval 3 figure.

goals.text: Residents receive at least five formal observations, one per cycle
goals.numerator_def: Enrolled first-year residents with at least one formal observation in every cycle completed so far (five by year end).

goals.text: Residents report leading full days of whole group instruction 3+ days a week by Cycle 3
goals.numerator_def: Survey respondents reporting they lead full days of whole group instruction 3 or more days a week.

goals.text: Residents report the pace of taking on new responsibilities felt appropriate
goals.numerator_def: Survey respondents who agree the pace of new responsibilities felt appropriate.

goals.text: Residents rated by mentor teacher as ready to manage own classroom next year
goals.numerator_def: Residents whose mentor teacher rates them ready to manage their own classroom next year.
goals.denominator_def: Residents with a completed mentor teacher survey rating.

goals.text: Residents report practicing leading instruction during mentor check-ins
goals.numerator_def: Survey respondents who report practicing leading instruction during mentor check-ins.

goals.text: Residents report meeting with mentor teacher at least weekly
goals.numerator_def: Survey respondents who report meeting with their mentor teacher at least weekly.

goals.text: Residents submit GRM Part 3 Progress Check on time each cycle
goals.numerator_def: Enrolled first-year residents who submitted the GRM Part 3 Progress Check on time in the cycle.

goals.text: Residents complete the Clinical Practice activity documented in GRM Part 3 each cycle
goals.numerator_def: Enrolled first-year residents who completed the GRM Part 3 Clinical Practice activity in the cycle.

goals.text: Residents independently complete at least one GRM Part 3 independence measure activity
goals.numerator_def: Enrolled first-year residents with at least one GRM Part 3 independence measure activity completed independently.

goals.text: Mentor teachers report mentoring positively impacted their experience at KIPP DC
goals.numerator_def: Mentor teacher respondents who agree mentoring positively impacted their experience at KIPP DC.

goals.text: Mentor teachers report their perspective is included in the formal evaluations their resident receives
goals.numerator_def: Mentor teacher respondents who agree their perspective is included in their resident's formal evaluations.

goals.text: Mentor teachers agree CTR adequately prepared their resident to manage student behavior
goals.numerator_def: Mentor teacher respondents who agree CTR adequately prepared their resident to manage student behavior.

goals.text: Residents have a weekly mentor teacher log completion rate of at least 70% for the year
goals.numerator_def: Enrolled first-year residents whose weekly Mentor Check-In Log completion rate for the year is 70% or higher.

goals.text: Residents agree CTR Advisor support gave them the knowledge needed to succeed
goals.numerator_def: Survey respondents who agree CTR Advisor support gave them the knowledge needed to succeed.

goals.text: Residents agree they are gaining knowledge and skills to prepare students for life beyond the classroom
goals.numerator_def: Survey respondents who agree they are gaining knowledge and skills to prepare students for life beyond the classroom.

goals.text: Residents agree CTR PD was relevant and beneficial
goals.numerator_def: Survey respondents who agree CTR PD was relevant and beneficial.

goals.text: Residents who do not show mastery on a Core PD exit ticket receive a targeted observation within two weeks
goals.numerator_def: Residents not showing mastery on a Core PD exit ticket who received a targeted observation within two weeks.
goals.denominator_def: Residents not showing mastery on a Core PD exit ticket.

goals.text: Residents score 2.0+ on the Essential Skills indicator(s) aligned to each Core PD session in the same cycle
goals.numerator_def: Enrolled first-year residents scoring 2.0 or higher on the Essential Skills indicator(s) aligned to the cycle's Core PD session.
goals.denominator_def: Enrolled first-year residents observed in the cycle.

goals.text: Residents score 3.0+ on each of the 5 certification assignments
goals.numerator_def: Enrolled first-year residents scoring 3.0 or higher on all five certification assignments.

goals.text: Residents agree certification assignments and clinical practice artifacts equipped them for senior resident or lead teacher
goals.numerator_def: Survey respondents who agree certification assignments and clinical practice artifacts equipped them for the senior resident or lead teacher role.

goals.text: Residents pass or are exempt from Praxis Core
goals.numerator_def: Enrolled first-year residents who passed or are exempt from all Praxis Core subtests.

goals.text: Residents pass Praxis Content Knowledge
goals.numerator_def: Enrolled first-year residents who passed the Praxis Content Knowledge test for their area.

goals.text: Residents pass Praxis Principles of Learning and Teaching
goals.numerator_def: Enrolled first-year residents who passed Praxis PLT.

goals.text: Residents are eligible for certification by program completion
goals.numerator_def: Enrolled first-year residents meeting every certification requirement (Praxis Core, Content Knowledge, PLT, coursework) at program completion.

goals.text: Incoming first-year residents hired by June 1
goals.numerator_def: Incoming first-year residents (2028 cohort) with a completed hire by June 1.
goals.denominator_def: Incoming first-year residents who accepted an offer.

goals.text: Residents agree at EOY that their experience matches recruitment messaging
goals.numerator_def: Survey respondents who agree their experience matches recruitment messaging.

goals.text: Incoming 2028 cohort identifies as Black men
goals.numerator_def: Incoming 2028 cohort members who identify as Black men.

goals.text: Incoming 2028 first-year secondary residents in the secondary math track
goals.numerator_def: Incoming 2028 first-year secondary residents placed in the secondary math track.

goals.text: First-year residents complete the CTR program
goals.numerator_def: First-year residents who complete the CTR program.
goals.denominator_def: Every first-year resident on the roster this year, including those who withdrew.

goals.text: Black male residents complete the program
goals.numerator_def: Black male first-year residents who complete the program. Calculated automatically from goal 31's resident results.
goals.denominator_def: Black male first-year residents on the roster this year, including those who withdrew.
goals.baseline_note: SY25-26 (5/6 listed in the goals doc)

goals.text: No demographic group's completion rate falls more than 10 points below the overall rate
goals.numerator_def: Demographic groups (race/ethnicity and gender, groups of 5 or more) whose goal 31 completion rate is more than 10 points below the overall rate. Calculated automatically from goal 31's resident results.
goals.denominator_def: Demographic groups with 5 or more residents.
goals.baseline_note: Not tracked at this level in SY25-26; establish baseline

goals.text: Residents agree they feel they belong
goals.numerator_def: Survey respondents who agree they feel they belong.

goals.text: Residents would recommend CTR to a friend
goals.numerator_def: Survey respondents who would recommend CTR to a friend.

goals.text: Residents feel confident about their teaching placement for next year
goals.numerator_def: Survey respondents who feel confident about their teaching placement for next year.

goals.text: Senior residents finish the school year
goals.numerator_def: Senior residents who finish the school year.
goals.denominator_def: Senior residents on the roster this year, including those who left.

goals.text: Senior residents plan to remain in teaching beyond their CTR commitment
goals.numerator_def: Senior resident respondents who plan to remain in teaching beyond their CTR commitment.

goals.text: Senior residents agree they have a clear understanding of their role
goals.numerator_def: Senior resident respondents who agree they have a clear understanding of their role.

goals.text: Senior residents agree CTR provided meaningful support to their development as a lead teacher
goals.numerator_def: Senior resident respondents who agree CTR provided meaningful support to their development as a lead teacher.

goals.text: CTR team delivers one dedicated senior resident touchpoint per sprint across all 6 sprints
goals.numerator_def: Sprints in which the CTR team delivered a dedicated senior resident touchpoint.
goals.denominator_def: Sprints completed so far (6 by year end).

goals.text: Senior residents secure a full-time teaching position for SY27-28 by May 1
goals.numerator_def: Senior residents with a signed full-time teaching position for SY27-28 by May 1.

goals.text: CTR Alumni in years 2 and 3 who lead teach at a KIPP DC school are rated Effective or higher on the CORE evaluation
goals.numerator_def: Year 2 and 3 CTR Alumni lead teaching at KIPP DC rated Effective or higher on the CORE teacher evaluation.
goals.denominator_def: Year 2 and 3 CTR Alumni lead teaching at KIPP DC with a CORE rating.

goals.text: Students taught by CTR Alumni in years 2 and 3 meet their EOY growth goal on the relevant exam
goals.numerator_def: Students of year 2 and 3 CTR Alumni meeting their EOY growth goal on the relevant exam (aggregate entry only).
goals.denominator_def: Students of year 2 and 3 CTR Alumni with EOY growth results.

goals.text: CTR Alumni fulfill their commitment to teach three years (2025 cohort)
goals.numerator_def: 2025 cohort CTR Alumni who complete three years of teaching.
